artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange, green, and rose
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene. The painting depicts a central figure seated with a smaller figure on their lap, surrounded by three other figures. The central figure wears garments adorned with a halo. The smaller figure on their lap appears to be holding an object or interacting with the other figures around them who seem to be in positions of admiration or worship. The figures are rendered in a medieval style with expressive lines and minimal color accents. The setting appears to be indoors, as indicated by architectural lines suggesting a structure or room. This is in the style of an early religious iconographic illustration.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.medium: woodcut in warm black ink, hand-colored in red lake, blue, yellow, rose, orange, and silver
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with figures surrounded by clouds and one prominent central figure radiating light. The central figure is depicted standing on a hilly landscape with rays emanating from its body. There are two figures seated on clouds above and three figures on the ground gazing up. All figures are dressed in vibrant robes and have halos. The scene uses bold outlines and vivid colors against a light background, typical of religious iconography. This style resembles medieval religious painters, often seen in illuminated manuscripts and ecclesiastical art.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, tan, blue, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals from the upper torso up. The person on the left is standing with their profile visible, wearing a long robe and a headpiece. They have visible facial hair and tousled brown hair. The other two individuals, a woman in the middle and a man to the right, are facing slightly towards the first person. The woman wears a red garment over a blue skirt and a head covering, while the man wears a green garment with a red lining. They stand on a green, grassy area with a red jar-like object on the ground near them. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with pink structures under a pale blue sky.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, blue, brown, and gray
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historical scene at a well. The image depicts two figures engaged in activity by a well situated in a pastoral setting. One figure is drawing water using a wooden bucket attached to a pulley system from the stone-constructed well. The other figure is seated next to the well. Behind them, a rolling landscape unfolds, with a hill, buildings, and towers in the distance under a softly colored sky. The colors are warm and earthy with shades of green, brown, and yellow dominating the palette.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Christ
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, yellow, blue-gray, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with two individuals and a third partially obscured by a doorway. The work has bold outlines and flat areas of color. The figures wear vibrant clothes in red and blue and stand on a green checkered floor. The setting appears enclosed, with an architectural archway framing the action. The style resembles medieval woodcut illustrations, known for strong lines, limited perspective, and direct storytelling. The scene is rich in color and detailed, with intricate clothing and facial expressions on the central figures.

artworks.title: Christ's Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.medium: woodcut in light brown, hand-colored in red lake, green, black, tan, orange, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting of an urban scene with architectural structures and figures interacting. The artwork depicts a cityscape with ancient-looking buildings in the background, characterized by varied roof shapes, towers, and domes with red and green hues. In the foreground, there are several figures in vibrant colored attire, centered around a mounted figure on a donkey. The buildings have detailed windows and stonework, suggesting a medieval or early Renaissance context. The style is reminiscent of early religious or historical paintings akin to illuminated manuscripts or iconographic depictions from the Middle Ages.

artworks.title: Christ's Entry into Jerusalem
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, yellow, brown, green, and gray
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historic city scene with a central figure on a donkey surrounded by other figures. The main image depicts a cityscape with buildings featuring towers and domes of various shapes and sizes. In the foreground, a central figure is riding a donkey, surrounded by other figures, some holding branches and laying garments on the ground. The scene is enclosed within a decorative border with panels containing intricate patterns and small illustrations, including figures writing and mythical creatures. The use of earthy tones like greens, reds, and browns along with fine lines suggest it is an example of manuscript or print work from the medieval or early renaissance period.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Apostles' Feet
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, blue, yellow, green, gray, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of individuals gathered in a scene. The composition shows several figures seated or kneeling on a tiled surface, enclosed by an orange and blue border. The characters are depicted with a medieval stylization featuring outlines, simplified forms, and expressive faces. The palette incorporates reds, blues, and earth tones, giving the image a textured feel. The style is reminiscent of artwork from the medieval or early Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red-brown lake, gray, yellow, rose, olive, and green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene featuring a man kneeling in prayer with a celestial figure above. The painting depicts the scene with the central figure on bended knee in a grassy area, surrounded by three people resting nearby. Above the central figure, there is a winged being holding a cross, gazing downward. In the upper right corner, a chalice is positioned on a ledge. The background showcases trees and wooden structures accentuated with simple yet bold lines.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, orange, brown, gray, and rose
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene featuring multiple figures in a stylized representation. The central figure with a halo is kneeling with hands clasped in prayer, looking upwards. Around the central figure, other characters, some also with halos, are seated or kneeling on green grass. In the background, a group of armed figures is depicted. An angel is shown in the upper right corner next to a tree branch and a goblet on a table. The scene is framed in an ornate border with symmetrical patterns of flowers and leaves in pink, green, and white. The figures are outlined in black with simple expressions, wearing robes colored in earth tones, red, brown, and beige. The composition suggests a scene of contemplation or a biblical narrative.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, carmine, rose, yellow, gray, blue, and brown
artworks.description: The image is of a religious scene in a garden. It shows a figure in the center kneeling with hands clasped before a group of resting figures. The setting is outdoors with trees and bushes. The composition includes a fenced area, a group of people near a door-like structure, a building with a tower, and a small flying figure with wings. In the background, there is a chalice on a hill. The style features outline drawings filled with flat, muted colors, likely influenced by historical religious art.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange-red, gray, green, rose, light yellow, brown, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with four figures. One central figure is in a praying posture, and another figure holds a cup in the background. The style is reminiscent of medieval religious artwork, with bold outlines and flat areas of color. The figures wear ornate robes and are adorned with halos. The background features stylized trees and rocks.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals with their upper bodies and heads visible. The central figure is kneeling with their face raised upward and hands clasped together. They have a bearded face with red marks or lines on their forehead and cheeks. There are three other individuals behind and next to the central figure, each with different facial expressions and hairstyles. All have halos around their heads. One person is wearing a red robe, while another is in green. In the background, there are large leafy plants or trees, creating a lush green environment.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue-green, orange, yellow, and tan
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group scene with seven figures. The figures are intricately dressed in varied garments, with colors such as yellow, green, and earthy tones predominating. The central figure appears to be the focal point, as the others are positioned around in different poses, with some extending arms or gesturing animatedly. Two figures have halos over their heads. The background is simplified with broad strokes of teal and pale colors, bordered by a thin orange frame. The scene conveys a sense of interaction and narrative intent, typical of stories depicted in illuminated manuscripts from the medieval period.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.medium: woodcut in dark brown, hand-colored in red lake, green, blue, orange, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows six individuals in an animated interaction. Most figures are depicted from the waist up, except two shown from head to toe, and one lying down. The central figure is standing, wearing a robe and a halo, holding a bag. The figures' facial features are stylized with simple, expressive lines. The central figure has long hair, while others have short hair or head coverings. The surrounding figures wear medieval-style clothing in earth tones and blues, some with green accents. The figure on the ground is bald and wearing a garment with a white collar. One individual holds a scroll or baton, while others interact with or gesture towards the central figure. The background has a blue sky and green ground, enclosed by a red border.

artworks.title: The Denial of Peter
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, green,brown, and ochre
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures interacting in a medieval scene. The image is an illuminated manuscript that features several figures depicted with halos. There are distinct color blocks throughout, like deep red robes and green accents. The background suggests architectural elements, possibly an interior space or a cityscape, with arches and a decorated wall or window. The figures are depicted with elongated forms and simple lines, typical of the medieval style.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.medium: woodcut in dark brown, hand-colored in vermilion, gray-blue, purple, peach, and tan
artworks.description: The central figure is tied to a blue column with both hands above their head. To the left, a person in red attire is shown mid-action with arms raised. To the right, two individuals stand observing. The background consists of a pale, decorated wall with an ornate circular design on the left side and an overhead architectural element above the group.

artworks.title: Christ Bearing the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red, yellow, light orange, tan, blue, black and tarnished silver leaf on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure carrying a large wooden cross surrounded by others. The main figure is struggling under the weight of the cross, with a halo around its head. The background shows a simple architectural structure, with green hills under a blue sky. The figures around the central individual are clad in colorful garments, red, yellow, and green being the prominent colors. They appear to be either assisting or impeding the central figure's movement. The style of this illustration offers a rich texture with bold outlines and a flat perspective.

artworks.title: Christ Bearing the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in mauve, red, blue, green, ochre, yellow, black, white, and gold, on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene featuring floral and avian motifs. The image depicts a figure in a purple robe with a cross on their back, surrounded by other figures in colorful robes. The painting is enclosed within an ornate border featuring vibrant flowers and a bird. The floral motifs include red, blue, and white blossoms, with a small bird perched on a green vine at the bottom of the frame. The style is reminiscent of medieval European religious art, with earthy tones and gold accents throughout.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in blue, orange, red, yellow, rose, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of multiple figures in historical attire. One central figure carries a heavy beam. The image depicts figures in medieval clothing, surrounding a central figure wearing a crown of thorns and bearing a wooden beam. The figures are tightly packed against a backdrop of a stone wall and a distant landscape. The colors are vivid with reds, blues, and earthy tones, framed by a red border. The style includes strong outlines and simple shading that emphasizes the expressions and postures of the figures. This style is akin to an early Renaissance or Late Gothic woodcut, often attributed to artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, tan, yellow, green, and gray on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a depiction of three figures centered around the crucifixion scene. The central figure is Jesus on a cross, with his arms outstretched and nailed to the wooden beams. He is wearing a crown of thorns and is clad in a simple cloth around his waist. His head is tilted downward, and his long hair and beard frame his face. On either side of Jesus are two individuals. To the left, a woman wearing a long robe and a head covering stands with her hands crossed in front of her. On the right is a man with curly hair and wearing a long robe. The background features the depiction of a sun and a moon in the sky, with a grassy hill underfoot and a skull at the base of the cross. The scene is framed in a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Pope Pius II
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 36 x 26 cm (14 3/16 x 10 1/4 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a religious scene. It shows a figure on a cross with an inscription "INRI" above. Additional figures with haloes are standing around the base of the cross, while another figure is depicted kneeling below. The composition is symmetrical, with text surrounding the central image on both sides, reflecting artistic conventions of the era.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, blue, green, brown, orange-red, and gold, on vellum
artworks.description: The image features three individuals shown from mid-thigh to the head. In the center, a man is hanging on a wooden crucifix with long brown hair and a beard. He wears a crown of green foliage and a cloth around his waist. Flanking him are two figures. On the left, a woman stands with hands clasped in prayer, wearing a pink robe, blue mantle, and a veil. She has a halo. On the right, a man in a green robe and red cloak stands with a halo, looking towards the center figure. The background is blue with plants, and a decorative frame surrounds the scene with floral patterns. Below is text with decorative scrollwork.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut on vellum
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with figures standing on either side of the cross. The central figure is depicted on a wooden cross with nails through the hands and feet, crowned with thorns and clothed in a loincloth. Each side of the cross has a figure cloaked in heavy garments, one looking mournful and the other gazing upward. The figures have halos around their heads. At the foot of the cross, there is a skull and bones. The composition uses fine lines and detailed shading to create an impression of depth and solemnity, characteristic of religious woodcut illustrations.
